title: An all-queued goal's Next passes over a parked queued task, as the scheduler does
description: In packages/db/src/store/goal-digest.ts, nextOf's queued fallback adds every open task whose latest workstream is QUEUED. The scheduler also skips a parked task (apps/daemon/src/scheduler/scheduler.ts, `if (task.boardColumnId !== null) continue;`). Example: in a goal with tasks A and B and no dependencies, both are queued, A leads the queue and is parked. The drawer shows Next = A, but the scheduler starts B.
acceptanceCriteria: In an all-queued goal, Next passes over parked queued tasks when one that isn't parked can start
goal-digest.test.ts covers a parked queued task that leads the queue
